_notes: Every action usable in an action list: { "do": "<action>", ...params }. 'sentence' is how the visualizer reads it aloud; {param} is replaced by the value. Actions run in order; wait and the fades pause the list.

fade_in.description: Fade the screen in from black. The list waits until the fade ends.
fade_in.sentence: Fade in from black over {ticks} ticks

fade_out.description: Fade the screen out to black. The list waits until the fade ends.
fade_out.sentence: Fade out to black over {ticks} ticks

play_music.description: Start a song (keeps playing if it is already the current song).

from.description: Copy this other variable's value instead of 'value'. Empty = use 'value'.

add_var.description: Add to a game variable (use a negative number to subtract). With 'from' and 'times' it adds another variable multiplied by a number.

from.description: Add this other variable's value instead of 'value'. Empty = use 'value'.

max_var.description: Never go above this other variable (health up to max health). Empty = no limit.

times.description: Multiply the amount by this first (sell 3 fish at 120 each: from the fish count, times 120; subtract a variable: from it, times -1).

reset_vars.description: Put every game variable back to its starting value (for a new game).
reset_vars.sentence: Reset all game variables to their starting values

if_var.description: Check a game variable and run one of two lists.

then.description: Runs when the check is true.

else.description: Runs when the check is false.

if_chance.description: Roll the dice: run one list with the given chance, the other list otherwise (random drops).

show_dialog.description: Open a dialog box. The game pauses until it closes.

open_menu.description: Open a menu. The game pauses until it closes.

spawn.description: Create an object (or a particle burst). Position is relative to the object running the action, or to the scene when 'relative' is false.

relative.description: Position is relative to the object running the action.

destroy_self.description: Remove the object running this action.

save_game.description: Save every game variable to the cartridge (needs game.save = true).

load_game.description: Load the saved game variables, if there is a save (needs game.save = true).

call.description: Run a custom C function from src/game/ (last resort).

function.description: Name of the C function: void name(Actor *self).

set_darkness.description: Darken the world (maps and sprites, not the HUD or boxes) for evening and night. 0 = normal, 16 = black. Every scene starts at 0.
